rows.thesis: China's electronic information manufacturing output grew 15.7% year-on-year in the first eight months of 2026.

evidence.quote: 1－8月份，规模以上电子信息制造业增加值同比增长15.7%，增速较去年同期高4.9个百分点。

rows.thesis: This publication presents 2023 to 2025 data according to the 2025-2027 PDA schedule.

evidence.quote: Esta publicação apresenta os dados dos anos de 2023 a 2025, conforme cronograma estabelecido no PDA 2025-2027.

rows.thesis: Humanoid robots will complement existing technologies rather than replace them.

evidence.quote: Nicht zu erwarten ist jedenfalls, dass Humanoide in Zukunft die derzeit auf dem Markt befindlichen Robotertypen ersetzen. Stattdessen werden sie bestehende Technologien ergänzen und erweitern.

rows.thesis: The 2016 global PV market grew significantly to at least 74.4 GW.

evidence.quote: The global PV market grew significantly, to at least 74 ,4 GW in 2016. With non-reporting countries, this number could grow up to 75,4 GW, compared to 50 GW in 2015 .
